ModMetaData.name: Wil's Role Modules : Intelligence
ModMetaData.author: Spaceman_Wil
ModMetaData.description: Assistant, Researcher and the specialties Analyst, Geneticist, Dark Scholar (Dark Study), Author, Mech Commander, Diplomat and Chemist. Experience comes from real research, scanning, Anomaly study, xenogerm, drug and medicine making, writing books, mech work and talking with outsiders; libraries, research labs and gene labs are recognised and speed learning; specialty bonuses apply only to a qualified pawn assigned to that exact specialty. Dark Study needs Anomaly, Geneticist needs Biotech and Author needs books to write: without them those specialties simply have no work. Early draft: offline builds and tests do not constitute RimWorld gameplay validation.
